verdict.rationale: The RTX 5080 ships with a software ecosystem (NVIDIA app, Project G-Assist, CUDA), so an official MCP server for agent control is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence documents one. G-Assist is a built-in AI assistant, not an MCP endpoint. The developer portal's llms.txt and the failed OpenAPI probes are adjacent at best and do not show an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
